The subtitle is [The Politics of Feasible Liberalism](https://marginalrevolution.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=520c9e37419434441dbb7d1b303ecb208d7c6df8b5b3c54bd2162d85d5d91ad3&blog_id=42693868&post_id=93060&user_id=262258391&subs_id=225460721&signature=51d051b9f0496c59ba4c6b7c5d955369&email_name=new-post&user_email=ishan.mail@gmail.com&encoded_&email_id=ed5f29f9d21272c598361af34dfb7257), and the author is Deirdre Nansen McCloskey.
